title: Spicy Ethiopian Lentil Stew
description: A hearty, flavorful stew originating from Ethiopia, made with red lentils, onions, garlic, ginger, and spices.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the onion, garlic, and ginger, and cook, stirring occasionally, until the onion is translucent.
Add the curry powder, cumin, and salt, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the lentils, tomato paste, and water. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, until the lentils are tender.
Stir in the warm beer (if using). Serve hot, garnished with fresh cilantro (if desired).
Serve with injera or over rice.
